$comment: DGA's OFFICIAL compliance checklist, transcribed verbatim from the workbook the user supplied: 'معايير تطبيق كود المنصات ، Compliance Criteria.xlsx', sheet 'Checklist'. This supersedes data/dga-criteria.json, which was a good-faith reading of design.dga.gov.sa/AssessmentCriteria prose and inferred NINE criteria where the real instrument has FIFTY-EIGHT. Column E (حالة التنفيذ) is the compliance status the assessed party fills in and is deliberately not carried here — this file is the questions, not anyone's answers.

source.file: معايير تطبيق كود المنصات ، Compliance Criteria.xlsx
source.title: قائمة التحقق لتطبيق نظام التصميم الموحد (كود المنصات)

$findings: ACCESSIBILITY IS NOT A CHECKLIST ITEM. Zero occurrences of WCAG, contrast, keyboard, ARIA, screen reader or إمكانية الوصول across all 58 criteria. The only two 'accessible' matches are incidental wording inside the privacy notice and help-resources items. The AssessmentCriteria PAGE lists إمكانية الوصول as assessment category one, defined as WCAG conformance — so DGA's own two artefacts disagree, and this is reported rather than resolved.
TIER LABELS DIFFER FROM THE PAGE. The checklist says المعايير الأساسية / المعايير الثانوية. dga-criteria.json recorded الامتثال الإلزامي / المعايير الموصى بها, taken from the page.
CRITERION 1 IS A ROLLUP, defined by DGA itself: 'هذا الشرط يعتمد على مدى تطبيق الشروط الاساسية' — if every essential criterion is fully applied, this one becomes fully applied.

THE SERVICE-LEVEL CRITERIA ARE ESSENTIAL, NOT RECOMMENDED. Sitemap (30), interaction design (36), Arabic-first content (37), error explanation (38), search (39), feedback mechanisms (40), privacy notices (41), visual consistency (42), terminology (43) and error handling (44) all sit in المعايير الأساسية. dga-criteria.json placed that whole family in the recommended tier, which understated the coverage gap.

NUMBERING GAP: the sequence runs 1–50 then jumps to 60–67, so 51–59 are absent. Either rows were removed before the file was shared or the numbering is not contiguous. Worth confirming with DGA before quoting a total.
